latest.title: The Line git blame Can't See
latest.subtitle: git blame tells you who touched a line last. For a line that's already been deleted, it has no answer at all.
latest.coverAlt: A column of code lines with one line missing, shown as a dashed gap. A magnifying glass beside the gap finds the missing line in a stack of history behind the file.

latest.title: The Fix That Only Reached Half the Server
latest.subtitle: We fixed a config file, restarted the app and watched one feature recover. The other kept failing for a day and a half.
latest.coverAlt: One config file icon at the centre with lines to two processes. The web process on the left ends in a green tick; the background worker on the right ends in a red cross.

latest.title: The Restart Command That Only Worked When a Human Typed It
latest.subtitle: A supervisor noticed the crash, ran the restart and failed every time. The command was right. The shell it ran in was not.
latest.coverAlt: Two lanes run the same terminal command. In the top lane a person runs it and it ends in a green tick. In the bottom lane a process supervisor runs it and it ends in a red cross.

latest.title: The Water That Flowed Backwards
latest.subtitle: One line of Go made our water meters report negative consumption. The fix we added afterwards was the same bug in disguise.
latest.coverAlt: A bar chart of one flat's water use per minute. Steady blue bars of fifty litres, then a red bar dipping below zero, then an orange bar twice the usual height, then steady blue bars again.
